name: Kanab Town Loop
note: An easy spin round Kanab under the Vermilion Cliffs: up 100 East past the shops, across 300 North, down the old highway and out along Kanab Creek Drive, home on 100 East

name: Kolob Terrace Climb
note: The big one: 390 m up US 89 through Kanab Creek Canyon, between the Vermilion and White Cliffs, to the summit at 1,877 m — and the long descent home the same way

name: Hoodoo Rim & the Tunnel
note: From the summit down past Hoodoo Rim's orange spires, through the galleried Kanab Creek Tunnel to the East Fork at Mt Carmel, and back up through it all

name: Arch Garden & Coral Pink Dunes
note: Off the canyon road onto Hancock Road: rolling through juniper benches past the Arch Garden to the Coral Pink Sand Dunes, along the dunes and back

name: Butte Valley Gravel
note: Monument Valley's mittens and Merrick Butte over the sage: the Eight Mile Gap gravel loop, east through the Vermillion subdivisions to Johnson Canyon, back west on US 89 under the buttes and home on the old highway

name: Johnson Canyon & the Movie Set
note: Up Johnson Canyon between its red walls — a gentle climb all the way, past the old western movie set's false fronts — to the canyon's head, and back down

name: Vermilion Cliffs Rollers
note: Rollers under the Vermilion Cliffs: south out of Kanab on 100 East, then Kaneplex Drive's swells out across the sage toward the Arizona line, and back

name: Pinnacles Trail
note: Onto the dirt: Tom's Canyon Trail and the Pinnacles Trail up through the slickrock above Kanab to the top of the bench, and back down
